reviewer: independent audit agent; did not build or edit MSEE R6

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
evidence: Purdue ECN and Archives identify MSEE.
GIS feature 646 supports a four-corner footprint; reopened shell bounds match the recorded source bounds.
findings: Geographic conversion is approximate, not surveyed.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, and scale
evidence: Read-only master audit shows one relative library instance at manifest XY (87.421, 215.992 m), unit scale and zero rotation; relative path resolves.
findings: No independent survey control or neighboring-corner residual was measured.

criteria.name: Form, height, and roof
evidence: GIS records four levels; model uses a plausible low-rise form and four major window courses.
findings: GIS `Extrution` field is 36 with no documented units; no surveyed elevation or roof drawing was reviewed.
Roof monitor, exact height and floor datums remain interpretive.

criteria.name: Facade, texturing, and entrance
evidence: Official Purdue ECN exterior photo supports red-brown brick, central dark entrance, semicircular fanlight and a smaller top window course.
R6 moves the paired doors/fanlight to the atrium-screen base, removes obsolete R5 arch geometry and reduces the top course.
findings: Glazing reads as uniformly opaque blue-gray panels and facade bays are highly repetitive.
Photo is perspective and uncalibrated; dimensions, window schedule, material values and all-side cadence remain estimates.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
evidence: Archives describes a two-storey glass atrium, laboratories and two pedestrian skyways; saved asset includes an atrium vignette.
findings: No reviewed as-built interior plan or section verifies room layout, stairs, present contents, or continuous circulation.
No legible interior review render accompanies R6.

criteria.name: Technical and evidence quality
evidence: Blender 5.2.3 reopen succeeded; expected collection/shell found; 1200 asset objects; no mesh lacks materials; no unpacked external images.
Dedicated R6 validation reports watertight shell and source bounds preserved.
Master registration check is read-only and passes manifest transform/path checks.
findings: Portability and validation establish technical integrity, not as-built fidelity.

sources_reviewed: Purdue BuildingShapes ArcGIS FeatureServer layer 0, feature 646; snapshot in audit/build_batch_a2/materials_science_and_electrical_engineering_msee_gis_feature.json
decision: Passes 8.0 threshold at 8.2/10. Metric roof/height and interior circulation remain unverified; score does not certify survey or as-built accuracy.
